subject: Junior Civil Construction Estimator, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Jr Civil Construction Estimator role advertised on SEEK. I live in Melton, and the role's mix of drawing review, take-offs and supplier pricing builds directly on the estimating coursework in my diploma.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. It included cost estimates and bills of quantities, hand calculations, and road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, so the numbers side of the ad suits me. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020, first on a community hall renovation and then on subdivision finishing works: reviewing drawings, checking the work against them, tracking procurement and materials, and coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors to keep work moving.

I haven't worked in a paid estimating role yet, and I use Excel but haven't used Bluebeam or E1, so those would be new to me. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and I can travel for remote works.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to come in and talk it through.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Junior Estimator, Infrastructure Services SA, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role with Infrastructure Services in Mile End, advertised on SEEK. The ad says you'd still hear from people who don't meet every criterion, so here is where I stand.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. The coursework covered cost estimates and bills of quantities, and road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads road and pavement guides. Reviewing drawings and putting quantities and costs against them is coursework I have done, not paid estimating work yet. My site experience is 11 months in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: a community hall renovation, then subdivision finishing works, where I reviewed drawings, did inspections, tracked procurement and materials, and coordinated with suppliers and subcontractors.

I haven't used Benchmark, and I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd like to hear how the estimating team is set up.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
